about.title: About Uddhava Agri Farms
about.lede: A native poultry breeding farm building a brand you can trust.
about.identityTitle: Rooted in Tradition. Raised with Care.
about.identityBody: Our name and our promise stand for two things: respect for traditional native poultry, and care for every bird we raise and every person who enquires.
about.storyPending: The farm's story, in the owner's own words, will appear here.
about.v1Body: Real photos, real IDs, and only details we have confirmed.
about.v2Body: Birds raised with attention, every day.
about.v3Body: Native varieties that are part of rural life in our region.
about.v4Body: You speak with the farm itself, not an agent.
about.heritageBody: Native poultry has long been part of village life across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. We want to present it with the professionalism it deserves.
about.peoplePending: Introductions to the people who run the farm will be added here.
about.visionBody: To become a recognised, trusted name for native poultry, where every buyer can see exactly what they are enquiring about.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lede: Answers to common questions. Anything marked pending will be confirmed by the farm before launch.
faq.pendingAnswer: The farm will confirm this before launch. For now, please ask on WhatsApp.
faq.ctaBody: Ask the farm directly on WhatsApp.

how.q: How do I enquire about a bird?
how.a: Open the bird's profile and tap "Enquire on WhatsApp". Your message will include the bird's ID, so we know exactly which bird you mean.

prices.q: Are prices shown on the website?
prices.a: No, prices aren't listed online. Send us the bird's ID on WhatsApp and we'll share the details.

channel.q: What is the best way to contact the farm?
channel.a: WhatsApp on +91 93912 29691 is the quickest way to reach us.

status.q: What do Available and Reserved mean?
status.a: Available birds are open for enquiry. Reserved birds are already being discussed with a buyer.

where.a: Our farm is in Lingapalem, Andhra Pradesh.

breedingInfo.q: Do birds come with breeding information?
breedingInfo.a: Where the farm has breeding information for a bird, it is shown on that bird's profile. If a field is empty, ask us on WhatsApp.

health.a: Health information appears on a bird's profile only when the farm has provided it. If you have questions, ask on WhatsApp.

bulk.q: Do you sell to breeders and businesses?
bulk.a: Yes. We welcome enquiries from poultry breeders, farm owners, resellers and bulk buyers.

bizHow.q: How do I make a business enquiry?
bizHow.a: Use the business enquiry option on the Contact page, or the "Discuss a business enquiry" button. It opens WhatsApp with a short template for type of business, birds, quantity and location.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft for review. This policy must be checked and approved before the website launches.
privacy.s1Body: This website does not have accounts and does not store enquiry forms on a server. When you use a WhatsApp button or the enquiry form, WhatsApp opens with a message you can review; nothing is sent until you press send.
privacy.s2Body: Messages you send us on WhatsApp are handled by WhatsApp under its own privacy policy. We use them only to respond to your enquiry.
privacy.s3Body: Your language choice is saved in your browser so the site stays in your language. You can clear it at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.s4Body: The website does not use analytics or advertising cookies at present. This section will be updated if that changes.
privacy.s5Body: For privacy questions, contact the farm on WhatsApp at +91 93912 29691.

proto.router: Preview addresses use #/. The live site will use normal URLs such as uddhavaagrifarms.in/birds.
proto.gateNote: If any point fails, generate again. An obviously synthetic image harms trust more than a clearly marked placeholder.
gate: Anatomy is correct: two legs, four toes each, one comb, natural beak, wattles and eye
Feathers look real: natural texture and small imperfections, not smooth or plastic
Shadows are natural and match one light direction; birds are grounded
Setting looks like a real Indian farm; no cages or western barns
Colour and light are calm and true to life
Posture is calm, with nothing aggressive
No AI artefacts: warped objects, merged birds, garbled text or melted edges
proto.placedImg: Placed as a labelled placeholder image
proto.placedVid: Placed as a labelled concept video
proto.exportNA: Export is not available in this view.
proto.tooBig: That video is over 60 MB. Please use a shorter or compressed clip.
